report_name: Paidwork Data Breach Exposes Personal Data of 23 Million Users

threat_actors.name: Unidentified Cybercriminals
threat_actors.description: The unidentified attackers responsible for the 'smash and grab' data theft from the Paidwork platform. They exfiltrated an 11 GB user database and offered it for sale on a cybercrime forum for financial gain.

attack_patterns.name: Data from Local System
attack_patterns.description: Attackers exfiltrated an 11 GB database containing the personal and financial information of over 23 million users from Paidwork's production systems.

identities.name: Paidwork
identities.description: An online microtask platform that suffered a data breach in March 2026, exposing the sensitive personal and financial data of over 23 million users.

identities.name: Paidwork Users
identities.description: A class representing the over 23 million users of the Paidwork platform whose personal and financial data was exposed in the breach.

infrastructure.name: Cybercrime Forum
infrastructure.description: A cybercrime forum on the dark web where the stolen 11 GB database from Paidwork was put up for sale in April 2026.
